page_title: REN 1-1 LEN | Rennes v Lens 21/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+11' Jeremy Stinat is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+10' Wesley Said (Lens) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
90+9' Hans Hateboer (Rennes) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
90+9' Referee Jeremy Stinat points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Lens players.
90+7' Houston, we have a problem! The referee has indicated that there will be a VAR review of the goal to look at a possible foul. The Lens players aren’t happy.
90+7' 1 - 1 Goal! M'Bala Nzola (Lens) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot inside the left post. It's 1:1.
90+4' Julien Stephan is forced to make a change. Alidu Seidu is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Leo Ostigard (Rennes).
90+3' It doesn’t look good for Alidu Seidu (Rennes); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
90+2' The corner from Angelo Fulgini (Lens) is intercepted by Steve Mandanda.

90+2' Andy Diouf (Lens) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender. The ball goes out of play and Lens have been awarded a corner kick.
90+1' The Lens players are exchanging some short passes.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Andy Diouf (Lens) commits a foul and Jeremy Stinat immediately signals a free kick.
89' Looks like Alidu Seidu (Rennes) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
87' Hamzat Ojediran (Lens) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
86' Hamzat Ojediran (Lens) picks up an injury.
82' Julien Stephan prepares a substitution. Ludovic Blas is replaced by Jordan James (Rennes).
80' Jhoanner Chavez goes off the pitch and Deiver Machado (Lens) comes on.
77' Hamzat Ojediran (Lens) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremy Stinat had an easy-decision to make.
74' Facundo Medina (Lens) receives a yellow card for infringement.
74' Angelo Fulgini (Lens) decides to have a shot at goal from the free kick, but it hits the defensive wall.
72' Foul! Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
69' The substitution is prepared. Henrik Meister (Rennes) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Arnaud Kalimuendo.
68' Julien Stephan has decided to substitute Albert Gronbaek and he is replaced by Amine Gouiri (Rennes).
68' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) is penalised for a foul. Jeremy Stinat had a clear view and blows his whistle.
67' Rennes have been awarded a corner kick.
66' A substitution has been made. Anass Zaroury goes off and Angelo Fulgini (Lens) comes on.
63' Lens players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
58' Hans Hateboer (Rennes) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Jeremy Stinat who sees an offensive foul.
57' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) takes the corner with a short pass.
56' Will Still decides to make a substitution. Adrien Thomasson will be replaced by Wesley Said (Lens).
56' M'Bala Nzola (Lens) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Remy Labeau Lascary.
52' 45:55 – this is the current ball possession ratio.

50' Adrien Truffert (Rennes) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Brice Samba, who pulls off a comfortable save!
50' Rennes keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
49' The Lens players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
46' Jhoanner Chavez (Lens) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Will Still probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Florian Sotoca (Lens). He is replaced by Hamzat Ojediran.
46' The whistle blows and Jeremy Stinat starts the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
40' The number of shots on goal at present is 3:0.
38' Baptiste Santamaria (Rennes) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
36' Lens seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
34' Remy Labeau Lascary (Lens) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
30' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) sends a cross into the box, but Brice Samba comes off his line to gather the ball.

29' Rennes win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal. Jeremy Stinat blows his whistle as Jonathan Gradit (Lens) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
28' The shots on goal statistics – 3:0.
24' 1 - 0 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Brice Samba no chance!
23' Arnaud Kalimuendo (Rennes) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
22' Abdukodir Khusanov (Lens) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jeremy Stinat blows for a foul. A penalty is awarded to Rennes!
22' Corner kick. Ludovic Blas (Rennes) is ready to send the ball into the box.

21' Brice Samba pulls off a great save to deny Albert Gronbaek (Rennes), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot to the right side of the goal. The ball goes out of play. Rennes are awarded a corner kick.
21' Rennes can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
20' Ludovic Blas (Rennes) works the corner short.
17' Brice Samba (Lens) launches into a thunderous tackle on his opponent and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
15' Great teamplay by Rennes as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
13' Lens control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
9' The Rennes players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
7' The goal by Lens is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
7' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Jeremy Stinat wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
6' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Remy Labeau Lascary (Lens) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.
4' Anass Zaroury (Lens) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.
